name: Auto Computation - Salary Deductions & Leave Adjustment (Salary Deductions)

parameters.query:
WITH 
emp AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    phone,
    avatar_url,
    COALESCE(salary, 0)::FLOAT AS salary,
    designation,
    joining_date::TEXT,
    employment_type,
    work_location,
    role
  FROM employees
  WHERE id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
  LIMIT 1
),
leaves AS (
  SELECT 
    leave_type AS "type",
    label,
    total::FLOAT,
    used::FLOAT,
    available::FLOAT,
    year
  FROM leave_balances
  WHERE employee_id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
    AND year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM '{{ $json.targetMonth }}-01'::DATE)::INT
),
month_att AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    date::TEXT,
    check_in,
    check_out,
    status,
    status_label,
    late_allowance_used,
    is_half_day_case,
    half_day_reason,
    notes,
    work_duration_minutes
  FROM attendances
  WHERE employee_id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
    AND TO_CHAR(date, 'YYYY-MM') = '{{ $json.targetMonth }}'
  ORDER BY date ASC
),
hol AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    name,
    date::TEXT,
    day,
    type,
    is_office_closed
  FROM holidays
  WHERE TO_CHAR(date, 'YYYY-MM') = '{{ $json.targetMonth }}'
),
leave_reqs AS (
  SELECT 
    id,
    leave_type,
    duration_type,
    start_date::TEXT,
    end_date::TEXT,
    days_count::FLOAT,
    status,
    comments
  FROM leave_requests
  WHERE employee_id = '{{ $json.targetEmployeeId }}'
    AND (
      TO_CHAR(start_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '{{ $json.targetMonth }}'
      OR TO_CHAR(end_date, 'YYYY-MM') = '{{ $json.targetMonth }}'
      OR id LIKE 'lev-adj-%'
    )
)
SELECT 
  row_to_json(emp.*) AS employee,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(l.*), '[]'::json) FROM leaves l) AS leave_balances,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(a.*), '[]'::json) FROM month_att a) AS attendances,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(h.*), '[]'::json) FROM hol h) AS holidays,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(r.*), '[]'::json) FROM leave_reqs r) AS leave_requests
FROM emp;
